explanation: The only related declaration is Rat.HeightOneSpectrum.natGenerator_dvd_iff in Mathlib/NumberTheory/Padics/HeightOneSpectrum.lean. It states `natGenerator v ∣ n ↔ ↑n ∈ v.asIdeal.map (IsIntegralClosure.intEquiv R)`, which is membership in the image ideal in ℤ. The target states `(n : 𝓞 ℚ) ∈ w.asIdeal ↔ natGenerator w ∣ n`, which is membership in the ideal itself. Getting from one to the other needs `map_natCast` and `Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff`. That is more than a direct instantiation, and this is exactly what the library's own proof does. `natGenerator` appears in no other Mathlib file, so I found no lemma that states the target directly.
